_comment: GitHub App manifest for the Castalia Course Provisioner. Creating a GitHub App is the ONE step GitHub has no pure-API for — but the manifest flow makes it a single click: POST this to https://github.com/organizations/CastaliaInstitute/settings/apps/new?state=<csrf> via a form (see automation/github-app-create.html), approve once, and GitHub returns the App id, private key, client id/secret, and webhook secret. Everything else (install, provision, connect) is API/click-driven. Customers never see this — they only OAuth-connect or click Install.
name: Castalia Course Provisioner
